name: B2B MG Promo Structure: Hook Body Proof CTA

segments.intent: Stop scroll with a product-like visual and a clear benefit promise.
segments.scriptPattern: Open with the pain point or visible result in one line.

segments.intent: Explain core value with usage, closeup and MG selling-point cards.
segments.scriptPattern: One benefit per shot, alternating closeup, usage and text card.

segments.intent: Show proof, comparison or social trust before the close.
segments.scriptPattern: Before/after or pain/solution; concrete and skimmable.

segments.intent: Close with action and a final remembered benefit.

rhythm.notes: Fast opening, value pulses through the middle, readable CTA hold.

packaging.subtitleStyle: lower-third bold sans-serif, single benefit per shot
packaging.titleCardStyle: MG card with icon/sticker and 1-line headline
packaging.overlayStyle: highlight box + arrow for key spec

structureAtoms.name: Result-first hook
structureAtoms.description: Open with the clearest product/result frame and a short benefit claim.
structureAtoms.usageRules: Use when prompt contains a concrete product or pain point.
structureAtoms.exampleMapping: 0–20% segment opens with product crop and top-bar headline.

structureAtoms.name: Fast cuts with value pulses
structureAtoms.description: Alternate 1.5–2.5s shots, one benefit per cut.
structureAtoms.usageRules: Use when target duration is under 20s and pace is fast.

structureAtoms.name: Bold MG subtitle
structureAtoms.description: Lower-third bold subtitle, one benefit per shot.
structureAtoms.usageRules: Use high subtitle density when source visuals are weak.

structureAtoms.name: Proof by contrast card
structureAtoms.description: Split layout for before/after or pain/solution.
structureAtoms.usageRules: Use when source has comparison footage or prompt mentions improvement.

structureAtoms.name: Readable CTA end card
structureAtoms.description: Hold final CTA with benefit recap and brand mark.

structureAtoms.name: Crop-zoom + benefit overlay
structureAtoms.description: Reuse the strongest source shot with crop/zoom; overlay benefit text.
structureAtoms.usageRules: Use when product closeup or usage slots have no direct source.

editingTechniques.name: Crop/zoom reuse
editingTechniques.description: Reuse a source shot with crop, push-in or repeat to satisfy a visual slot.
editingTechniques.usageRules: Limit reuse to twice; vary motion direction.

editingTechniques.name: Title bar emphasis
editingTechniques.description: Bold title bar + short subtitle to make weak footage understandable.
editingTechniques.usageRules: Use high subtitle density for B-end MG.

editingTechniques.name: Hard-cut transitions
editingTechniques.description: Hard cuts between segments to keep MG pace.
editingTechniques.usageRules: Avoid soft dissolves in fast-pace promos.

qualityRationale: Hook + value body + proof + CTA mirrors successful B-end MG promos; replacement policy keeps the system from copying sample frames.

sourcePolicy.notes: Mock fallback template transfers structure only; does not reuse sample visuals.
